items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: My name was Oliver, myself, Oliver and Johnny Dash... Johnny Dash was playing.

ctx.x: Well, or his drummer was very happy. He was too young.
My name was Oliver, myself, Oliver and Johnny Dash. Yeah.

Was you called in the next draft, I mean next call, I was supposed to go in the next one? I was called in the first one. They had me working in the shipyard in the morning. I was so happy. I said, everyone knock off, everything's okay. No more work. Boy, I jumped on top of the streetcar. Listen, you want me to talk? Yeah. You want me to talk? Yeah. You want me to talk?
